title: What Actually Happens Inside Your Brain? 🧠
description:
Your brain is a tiny overworked employee that never gets a day off. Here is what it is really doing all day... and all night.
#shorts #brain #science #funny

scenes.say: Imagine a tiny employee inside your head, working twenty four hours a day, with zero holidays. That is your brain.
A ball flies at you? BOOM. Your brain works out its speed and direction, and tells your body to move, in a split second.
Touch a hot pan? That one is not even the brain's call. Your spinal cord yanks your hand back first, and the brain only hears about it later.
All of this runs on about eighty six billion neurons, passing messages like the world's busiest WhatsApp group.
But here is the ridiculous part. It remembers a random song from ten years ago... and forgets why you walked into the kitchen.
And it loves replaying that embarrassing moment from 2017... at three in the morning.
Even while you sleep, it never clocks out. It keeps your heart beating and sorts through your memories all night.

Basically, your brain is the CEO, the security guard, and the entertainment department, all at once. And somehow, it still makes you check your phone for the time... while the time is already on your phone.
